# Noto Sans CJK

The generated Simplified Chinese bitmap glyph subset in
`src/ui/assets/chinese_font_assets.cpp` was rasterized from Noto Sans CJK SC
Regular at 24px, then resampled per display size for the e-paper panel.
Noto Sans CJK is Copyright 2014-2021 Adobe and licensed under the SIL Open
Font License, Version 1.1.

Upstream: <https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk>

The complete OFL 1.1 license text is stored beside this notice as `OFL.txt`.
